# StatefulElementBase

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Provides lifecycle state for elements that continue rendering across page boundaries.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`. Extends `ElementBase`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new StatefulElementBase()
```

## Methods

- [`renderStateful`](#renderstateful): Renders as much of the element as fits on the current page and reports whether it is complete or needs another page.
- [`resetState`](#resetstate): Clears the continuation state so the element can be rendered again from the start.

### `renderStateful`

```typescript
renderStateful(ctx: RenderContext, width: number): RenderStatus
```

Renders as much of the element as fits on the current page and reports whether it is complete or needs another page.

### `resetState`

```typescript
resetState(): void
```
